results.bound: O\left(n^{1+1/c}\log\frac{1}{\delta}+Lk\right) \text{ distances in expectation, where } c=\text{contrast}_{d,k|n}(\mathbf{T}), \text{ for } L\in\Omega\left(n^{1/c}\right)
results.quote: On a D-dimensional time series T of length n, with parameters k ≥ 1, d ∈ [1, D], δ ∈ (0,1), Algorithm 1 computes O(n^{1+1/c} log 1/δ + Lk) distances in expectation, where c = contrast_{d,k|n}(T), for L ∈ Ω(n^{1/c}).
Algorithm 1 has space complexity proportional to O(K·L·D·n).
With the tensoring approach the index construction takes time proportional to O(D·K·√L·n log n).
When called with failure probability \delta'=\delta/k, Algorithm 1 finds the true top-k motifs with probability \ge 1-\delta.
